claim: The sample board never changes existing real progress, and its demo record is deleted when leaving.
where: demo banner, landing action, privacy page, README
sandbox: seed real progress; play /demo; assert the real record is unchanged, then leave and assert the demo record is deleted

claim: The sample has four marked tiles that each need one turn, for a four-turn best result.
where: landing caption, sample board stat, README
sandbox: fresh /?demo=1 context; assert four marked tiles each need one turn, visible Fewest 4, and a win after exactly four turns

claim: Progress stays in this browser and play sends no third-party requests.
sandbox: complete a fresh demo run while recording every request; assert same origin only

claim: Tiles work with Enter, Space, and arrow keys.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; rotate with Enter and Space, then move focus with an arrow key

claim: Home always opens today’s UTC board; archive, demo, and prior-date progress cannot replace it.
sandbox: complete today, play an archive, reload home, then inject a prior-date legacy record and assert today remains

claim: Archive practice is available from fresh state and rises from 4 to 20 to 25 misplaced tiles.
sandbox: open home with empty storage; assert all three controls are enabled, play each route, validate rising pars, then assert a legacy completion marker cannot lock them

claim: The first three real visits show three different lessons.
sandbox: visit home four times in a fresh context and assert three staged lessons followed by the standard keyboard tip

claim: Restart this board restores its starting state.
sandbox: turn a tile, restart, and compare the tile and turn count

claim: Winning requires one continuous dock-to-harbor route.
sandbox: script the exact four-turn sample solution and assert the connected-route medal screen

claim: Every run ends with a win or turn-limit loss screen and a one-tap restart.
sandbox: reach both end states in /demo and restart from each

claim: Completed progress, best score, and sound setting survive reload.
sandbox: complete /demo, change sound, reload, and assert restored end screen and values

claim: Sample, daily, and three archive modes load five distinct seeded routes.
sandbox: load the sample, daily, and all three archives; compare all five route signatures

claim: Copy result copies the game, board, turns, fewest score, and route result.
sandbox: complete /demo, copy the result, and assert the exact clipboard text and confirmation

claim: The daily board shows its UTC date identifier and includes that identifier in the copied result.
where: daily game heading, copied result, README
sandbox: open a fresh daily board; match its visible identifier to the UTC date, solve it, and assert the exact clipboard text contains the same identifier

claim: A round is designed as a two-to-five-minute puzzle break.
sandbox: open home and assert the visible 2–5 minute design intent; read README and assert the same intended duration in words

claim: Twenty date seeds produce at least 12 continuous route layouts.
sandbox: generate 20 dated boards and require at least 12 distinct topology signatures

claim: The fixed game loop targets 60 frames per second.
sandbox: measure 90 requestAnimationFrame intervals and fixed-step progress at 390x844 under 4x CPU slowdown

claim: The fixed game loop runs zero simulation steps while the page is hidden.
sandbox: simulate page visibility changes and assert zero fixed-step progress while hidden, then assert it resumes

claim: The full board fits at 390px and touch controls are at least 44px.
sandbox: fresh 390x844 touch context; assert full board bounds, tap a tile, and measure every visible link and button

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh context; install the worker, go offline, and reload /demo

claim: A new deployment replaces the previous offline cache.
sandbox: dedicated context; add a stale deploy cache, reinstall the versioned worker, and assert removal

claim: Hashed assets use immutable caching and pages ship a strict CSP policy.
sandbox: read the built deployment policy and assert CSP, immutable assets, and uncached worker rules

claim: Play is free and has no accounts, payments, timers, lives, or leaderboards.
sandbox: fresh /demo context; assert no forms or timer changes during play

claim: The harbor illustration is original AI-generated artwork with recorded provenance.
sandbox: read the local asset sidecar and design record; assert deployment, model, generation date, prompt, and provenance path
